tob-0039-d9: This microfilm roll keeps a piece of the Doctors’ Trial record at Nuremberg — the case against the Nazi medical corps for cruel tests. The court’s record covers proof, pleas, and rulings. Scholars dig in it for the full tale of the trial.
frus-1943-cairo-tehran-d9: President Roosevelt to Marshal Stalin, June 18, 1943 — Document 9. The president wrote Moscow again. The message is the persistence: the correspondence, maintained.
